svg.title: State value becomes an action increment
svg.desc: Three-action model | offensive = scoring probability change | defensive = reduction in conceding probability Held-out action-type means, not player rankings or causal effects. Action mix and calibration affect these values; no confidence intervals shown. The first action of each period and incomplete ten-action windows are excluded. Inferred dribbles in the value cohort: England 7,408, France 7,922. Official penalty/corner priors are retained; period boundaries and post-own-goal baselines reset explicitly.
